helper.purpose: Captions, stat descriptions, table headers, counts.

label.purpose: Uppercase printed marks on card and pack objects only.

card-cost.purpose: Power/toughness and cost numerals on thumbnails.

card-small.purpose: Type line, rules text, artist on thumbnails; semi-condensed. The 11px floor.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Every card thumbnail at rest; mythic face-up cards tint it orange-950 at 50%.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Card hover, paired with a 4px rise.

shadows.name: overlay
shadows.purpose: Dialogs; the pack wrapper uses the same shape at 0.7.

shadows.name: pip
shadows.purpose: Mana pips on the card title bar.

motion.name: ease-out-expo
motion.purpose: The one easing curve for movement: overlays, card lift, reveals, flip, foil sweep.

motion.name: duration-color
motion.purpose: Color, background and border transitions on controls.

motion.name: duration-overlay
motion.purpose: Dialog and toast entry (fade + 12px/8px rise), card hover lift, reduced-motion flip crossfade.

motion.name: duration-reveal
motion.purpose: Face-down cards entering after the tear; wrapper hover and tear crimp.

motion.name: card-flip
motion.purpose: 3D rotateY flip on reveal; reduced motion swaps it for a 200ms opacity crossfade.

motion.name: foil-sweep
motion.purpose: One light band across foil/mythic art on appearance (motion-safe only); hover replays via a 1.1s transition.

motion.name: tear
motion.purpose: Wrapper tear before cards appear; instant under reduced motion.

narrative.overview:
CardForge is a dark, quiet workbench. The card art is the most saturated thing on screen. Everything else (header, panels, tables, controls) sits on a cool slate-navy ramp and recedes, the way a light table disappears under the cards laid on it. Chrome is flat and separated by tonal steps and hairline borders. Cards are the objects on the table, and they are the only things that cast shadows.

Two accents, two jobs. Hologram Cyan marks tools and data: the primary action, selected states, focus, caret, selection, and the distribution bars. Foil Gold is held back for the one authored moment, the pack-opening ceremony, where you tear the wrapper, flip the cards one by one, and a mythic gets a light sweep and confetti. The rest of the product is Operate mode: dense, legible, keyboard-friendly, with 44px touch targets on coarse pointers.

Controls are precise and quiet: small radii, hairline borders, one bright filled action. Nothing in the chrome competes with the art.
keyCharacteristics: Dark only (`color-scheme: dark`), deepest surface is a near-black blue-void.
Tonal layers for chrome, real shadows only for cards, the pack wrapper, dialogs and toasts.
One typeface, Archivo variable. Card faces use its semi-condensed width (87.5%).
Tabular numerals everywhere by default. Large stat values switch to proportional.
Identity color (mana, rarity) lives in swatches, pips, frames and badges, all drawn from two lookup maps.
Motion uses one curve, expo-out, and every movement has a reduced-motion alternative.

rules.name: The Light Table Rule
rules.body: The card art is the most saturated thing on screen. Chrome draws only from the slate ramp, Hologram Cyan and status colors; any new chrome color has to lose to the art.

rules.name: The One Bright Action Rule
rules.body: A view carries one filled Hologram Cyan button, its primary action. Everything else is secondary (Raised), ghost, or a soft cyan selection state. Selection is shown with Cyan Depth fills and Cyan Edge borders, never a second solid cyan fill.

rules.name: The Foil Is Ceremony Rule
rules.body: In the app chrome, Foil Gold appears only in pack opening: the Open pack button, the wrapper, the card back. Never use it for a generic highlight, badge or warning; warnings use `warning`.

rules.name: The Swatch Speaks Rule
rules.body: Text never wears mana colors. A color's identity comes from the swatch, pip or frame beside the text, which stays in the neutral text ramp. Rarity colors may tint short labels and counts, and only through the RARITY map.

rules.name: The Single Source Rule
rules.body: Rarity and mana presentation comes only from the `RARITY` and `MANA` maps in `src/utils/cardHelpers.ts` (label, text, badge; swatch, frame, bar). Don't compose identity styling inline from raw palette steps; add a field to the map.

rules.name: The Tabular Default Rule
rules.body: `body` sets `font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums`, so counters, pack numbers and table columns don't shift when values change. Only the large Stat values opt out to proportional numerals.

rules.name: The 11px Floor Rule
rules.body: No text below 11px (0.6875rem). 11px is reserved for card faces and pack/card objects (`card-small`, `label`). App chrome starts at 12px.

rules.name: The Two Widths Rule
rules.body: Semi-condensed width (`font-stretch: semi-condensed`, 87.5%) belongs to card and pack faces. Chrome uses normal width.

rules.name: The Cards Lift Rule
rules.body: If it isn't a card, the pack wrapper, a dialog or a toast, it has no shadow. Separate chrome with a surface step or a hairline instead.

rules.name: The 63:88 Rule
rules.body: A card face always renders at 63:88, at every size and in every context (grid, ceremony, inspect). Responsive behavior changes what's inside the card, never its proportion.

rules.name: The Reduced-Motion Twin Rule
rules.body: Every movement ships with a reduced-motion alternative. Flips become crossfades, rises become fades, the tear becomes instant, and the sweep and confetti are dropped. Motion is never the only signal: foil still reads from the rarity ring and the Foil tag.

dos: Do take every color from the semantic roles in `src/index.css` `@theme` (`bg-panel`, `text-fg-muted`, `bg-accent`), never raw palette steps in chrome.
Do give each view one filled Hologram Cyan button for its primary action. Use Raised secondary or ghost buttons for everything else.
Do separate chrome with surface steps (Void → Well → Panel → Raised) and 1px hairlines.
Do put identity in a swatch, pip, frame or badge from the `MANA` and `RARITY` maps, next to neutral text.
Do keep card faces at 63:88 and art windows at 311:226, and set card text in Archivo's semi-condensed width.
